\section{Certified computation and independent replay}\label{up:sec:computation}

The computational proof follows three rules.

\paragraph{Exact data.}
All polynomial coefficients and parameters are parsed from decimal or
rational strings, never from binary floating-point literals.  Equality of
the inner and outer correlation constants is checked in exact rational
arithmetic.

\paragraph{Continuum coverage.}
Every compact domain is a union of closed rational intervals.  Arb evaluates
an inclusion extension on each cell.  Analytic monotonicity or derivative
signs treat the unbounded tails.  A dense floating scan is not proof and is
used only during search.

\paragraph{Independent implementations.}
The final exact-diagonal/outer-transfer package contains two author checkers, a
non-importing replay, and an adaptive referee replay.  The latter two
reconstruct the functions and constants instead of importing author code.
They use different subdivisions and endpoint reductions.  These four final
checkers use 512-bit precision.  The logically upstream six-stage rate chain
and its direct-region replay use 256-bit precision.  Every one of these
programs uses \texttt{python-flint==0.9.0} and therefore shares the same Arb
containment kernel: implementation diversity is not an independent arithmetic
kernel or a proof-assistant formalization.

The canonical rate loader rejects duplicate JSON keys, missing or unknown
schema fields, non-string numeric data, and non-finite decimal strings.  In
\texttt{--require-paper-chain} mode it additionally checks the six filenames,
their order, and their complete file hashes before interval evaluation.  The
canonical reproduction wrappers also refuse optimized Python mode, in which
proof-critical \texttt{assert} statements would otherwise be disabled.

This table, the six complete rate-certificate hashes in Appendix C, and
\path{external_sources/manifest.json} form the upper-bound evidence index.
The compact ratio, exact-diagonal, and outer-wedge cells are deterministic
rational partitions generated by the tracked checkers; they are not separate
untracked cell files.  The top-level \path{artifacts/MANIFEST.tsv} has a
different role: it lists only the large finite CNF/DRAT release payloads.

From the repository root, a lightweight replay of the exact-diagonal and
outer-transfer certificates is
\begin{verbatim}
bash scripts/bootstrap.sh
bash scripts/reproduce_upper.sh
\end{verbatim}
The first command creates a Python 3.11 environment with exact dependency
versions.  The second runs the four final transfer checkers; it deliberately
does not replay the six-stage rate chain.  The complete upper-bound replay,
including all six rate certificates, both Ramsey-region orientations, the
combinatorial audit, and all four final transfer checkers, is
\begin{verbatim}
.venv/bin/python reproduce.py full
\end{verbatim}
The unified manuscript is compiled separately with
\texttt{make paper}.
